answer.answer: The package contains two 2025 W-2s: Lena Fictus with Box 1 wages of $103,000.00 and Omar Fictus with Box 1 wages of $96,000.00. Summing these per the qualifying income definition gives a total of $199,000.00. A 2026 payslip for Lena is present but is treated as corroborating evidence only and is not added to the total.
caveats: Both W-2s are for tax year 2025, which is the latest year present in the package.
A September 2026 payslip for Lena Fictus is in the package but is corroborating only and excluded from the qualifying income total per package ontology rules.
W-2 units have no structured fields in this pipeline version (v1.0); Box 1 figures were read directly from chunk text.
